visualCharacteristics.purpose: row of three corporate cards (image, heading, text, 1-2 CTAs) that overlap the end of a colored band above
visualCharacteristics.description: Orange (#FF7400) band with faint world-map line graphic. White multilingual paragraph with underlined 'We are NXP' link and two white-outline pill buttons. The orange band ends roughly halfway down the three cards below, which sit on white (overlap effect). Cards: image on top, bold H3, body text, outlined/black pill buttons.

contentPattern.structure: one row per card; cell 1 = image; cell 2 = H3 title, paragraph, 1-2 CTA links
contentPattern.description: Three look-alike items (image, heading, text, buttons) that flow and wrap.

usage: Corporate value cards placed directly after an intro section with a colored background.
reuseGuidance: Generic image/heading/text/CTA card grid; the overlap effect is applied in the design pass.
